label: Delayed repair feasibility
title: Can a controller rescue a damaged Rule-54 target after waiting two steps?
summary: On a fixed 12-cell Rule-54 target, 36 of 96 one-bit injuries return by step four. None of the remaining 60 can be rescued by a one-bit flip after waiting two steps, even when the controller sees the full state.
takeaway: Passive return does not imply that a delayed intervention can help. Under this action and endpoint contract, searching for a more compact observer cannot improve control.
